fix(build): skip UPX compression for android binaries

UPX self-extracting stubs need writable+executable memory, which Android 10+ W^X forbids, so every android asset failed to exec in Termux with 'unsupported e_shentsize: 0x0'. Exclude all android-* platforms from the UPX step in the release workflow and both build scripts.

Fixes #61
